prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Updated episode ordering so duplicates insert right after their original and deletes close gaps with contiguous 1..N numbering, added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore with workspace-scoped 404 authorization, added localized Undo toast support on the Episodes page, and updated/added backend tests.

check.why: copy, dense order and restore all work together, guarded, page actions in both languages, tests and changelog

+@router.post("/{episode_id}/restore", response_model=EpisodeOut)
+def restore_episode(

+    session: Session = Depends(deps.get_session),
+    episode_id: UUID,

+    """

+    """
+    episode = session.get(Episode, episode_id)

+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    project = session.get(Project, episode.project_id)
+    if not project or project.deleted_at is not None:

+
+    try:
+        user_uuid = UUID(current_user_id)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID)
+
+    member = session.exec(
+        select(WorkspaceMember)
+        .where(WorkspaceMember.workspace_id == project.workspace_id)
+        .where(WorkspaceMember.user_id == user_uuid)
+    ).first()
+    if not member:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    if episode.deleted_at is None:
+        raise AppException(
+            error_code=ErrorCode.VALIDATION_INVALID_INPUT,
+            detail="Episode is not deleted",
+        )
+
+    active = _active_episodes_ordered(session, episode.project_id)
+    insert_idx = max(0, min((episode.episode_order or 1) - 1, len(active)))
+
+    episode.deleted_at = None
+    session.add(episode)
+    active.insert(insert_idx, episode)
+    _renumber_episodes(session, active)
+
+    session.commit()
+    session.refresh(episode)
+

+

+        project_id=episode.project_id,

+    session.add(new_episode)

+
+    active.insert(insert_idx, new_episode)
+    _renumber_episodes(session, active)
+
+    orig_cuts = session.exec(

+

+            appearing_characters=copy.deepcopy(orig_cut.appearing_characters) if orig_cut.appearing_characters is not None else [],
+            embedding=list(orig_cut.embedding) if orig_cut.embedding is not None else None,
+            refer_prev_cut=orig_cut.refer_prev_cut,
+        )
+        session.add(new_cut)
+        if first_cut_image_path is None and orig_cut.image_path:
+            first_cut_image_path = orig_cut.image_path
+
+    session.commit()
+    session.refresh(new_episode)
+
+    return _serialize_episode(session, new_episode, first_cut_image_path=first_cut_image_path)

+from uuid import UUID, uuid4

+def _create_project(client, headers, title="Test Webtoon"):
+    r = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json={"title": title, "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_episode(client, headers, project_id, title="Episode 1", order=1, summary="Opening arc"):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "title": title,
+            "project_id": project_id,
+            "episode_order": order,
+            "story_summary": summary,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()
+
+
+def _create_cut(
+    client,
+    headers,
+    episode_id,
+    *,
+    cut_order,
+    script,
+    selected_layout="wide",
+    aspect_ratio="16:9",
+    dialogues=None,
+    appearing_characters=None,
+    image_path=None,
+    refer_prev_cut=True,
+):
+    r = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={
+            "episode_id": episode_id,
+            "cut_order": cut_order,
+            "script": script,
+            "selected_layout": selected_layout,
+            "aspect_ratio": aspect_ratio,
+            "dialogues": dialogues or [],
+            "appearing_characters": appearing_characters or [],
+            "image_path": image_path,
+            "refer_prev_cut": refer_prev_cut,
+        },
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    cut = r.json()
+    if appearing_characters is not None or refer_prev_cut is False:
+        upd = client.put(
+            f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut['id']}",
+            headers=headers,
+            json={
+                "appearing_characters": appearing_characters or [],
+                "refer_prev_cut": refer_prev_cut,
+            },
+        )
+        assert upd.status_code == 200, upd.text
+        cut = upd.json()
+    return cut
+
+

+    cut1 = _create_cut(
